作用：启用执行策略文档的原生状态条件化。用途：让模型遵守既定的工程策略。推荐值：: Purpose: Enable native state conditioning for execution policy documents. Use: Ensure the model follows established engineering policies. Recommended: Enabled.

作用：开启后，POST /v1/responses/compact 生成普通文本: Purpose: When enabled, POST /v1/responses/compact generates a plain-text summary and reuses the saved DeltaNet state and high-surprisal K/V from the previous turn; when disabled, the endpoint rejects requests. Enabled by default.

作用：每个请求最多允许的刷新次数（当前实现最多 1 次）。推荐值：1。: Purpose: Maximum number of refreshes allowed per request (the current implementation supports at most 1). Recommended: 1.
作用：每个高惊奇 token 周围保留的上下文长度。用途：半径越大上下文越完整，: Purpose: Context length retained around each high-surprisal token. Use: A larger radius provides more complete context, but merged spans are more likely to exceed the budget. Recommended: 16.

作用：触发点之前保留的注意力查询快照数。推荐值：8。: Purpose: Number of attention query snapshots retained before the trigger point. Recommended: 8.
作用：触发点之后保留的注意力查询快照数。推荐值：4。: Purpose: Number of attention query snapshots retained after the trigger point. Recommended: 4.

作用：调度器同时处理的请求数上限。用途：限制并发防止拥塞排队。推荐值：64；单人: Purpose: Maximum number of requests the scheduler can process concurrently. Use: Limit concurrency to prevent congested queues. Recommended: 64; for a single user, 1–8 provides faster responses.

作用：长文档中保留精确键值缓存的片段总量。用途：越大精确事实保留越多，但占用上下: Purpose: Total budget for exact K/V fragments retained from long documents. Use: Larger values preserve more exact facts but consume more context. Recommended: 2048.

固定设置第一道 Q×K 门禁的分数与领先差距要求：高召回偏覆盖，标准保持平衡，高: Preset the score and lead-margin requirements for the first Q×K gate: High Recall favors coverage, Standard balances both, and High Precision prioritizes fewer false recalls.
在工具轨迹空闲后提炼可复用经验，热写入知识库并重建原生 Tensor Bank。: Extract reusable experience after a tool trajectory becomes idle, hot-write it to the knowledge base, and rebuild the native Tensor Bank.
在指定模型层施加低秩激活修正，使行为贴近已训练轨迹；强度档位决定修正幅度与结构失: Apply low-rank activation corrections at specified model layers to align behavior with trained trajectories; the strength level determines the correction magnitude and risk of structural distortion.
外部知识均未通过准入时，只让最新工具结果中的明确事实作为当前请求的临时证据；不能: When no external knowledge passes admission, use only explicit facts from the latest tool result as temporary evidence for the current request; inject nothing if they cannot be verified.

定义 Attention-Q × K 召回、语义准入及原生状态注入的门限与预算；: Define thresholds and budgets for Attention-Q × K retrieval, semantic admission, and native state injection; control the complete pipeline from candidate generation to actual context inclusion.
定义一次因果回放比较的最大候选分支数；每增加一份都会增加内部评分开销，推荐 2。: Set the maximum number of candidate branches for one causal replay comparison; each additional branch increases internal scoring overhead. Recommended: 2.
定义候选排序后真正施加注意力控制的最大历史块数；增加扩大覆盖，但可能引入噪声，推: Set the maximum number of historical blocks that receive attention control after candidate ranking; increasing it expands coverage but may introduce noise. Recommended: 2.
定义单个调度批次累计读取的提示 token 上限；影响首字延迟与吞吐的平衡，推荐: Set the maximum total prompt tokens read per scheduler batch; this balances time to first token and throughput. Recommended: 65536.
定义单份文档可编译入 Tensor Bank 的最大 token 数；普通文档推: Set the maximum tokens per document that can be compiled into the Tensor Bank; 4096 is recommended for regular documents. Increase only for long-trajectory experiments.
定义单次请求可进入模型的最大 token 容量；调大可承载更长历史，调小可降低显: Set the maximum token capacity the model can accept per request; increase it for longer history or reduce it to lower VRAM pressure. Recommended for the current dual-GPU setup: 102400.
定义历史轨迹可获得的绝对注意力加权上限，防止历史覆盖当前输入，推荐 0.25。: Set the absolute attention-weighting cap for historical trajectories to prevent history from overriding the current input. Recommended: 0.25.
定义历史轨迹是否参与注意力加权；仅观察只记录选择，主动控制施加上限内偏置，关闭用: Set whether historical trajectories participate in attention weighting; Observe Only records selections, Active Control applies bias within the cap, and Off is for a pure baseline.
定义召回轨迹控制台的默认显示范围：记忆活动保留注入或 Self-Ask 请求，仅: Set the default display scope for the recall trajectory console: Memory Activity includes requests with injection or Self-Ask, Actual Recall Only is stricter, and All Requests supports full auditing.
定义同一请求两次观测干预的最小 token 间隔；重复触发较多时提高，推荐 64: Set the minimum token interval between two observation interventions in the same request; increase it if repeated triggers are frequent. Recommended: 64.
定义启动时为模型权重与 KV/GDN 缓存预留的显存比例；提高可增强容量，降低可: Set the share of VRAM reserved at startup for model weights and KV/GDN caches; increase it for more capacity or reduce it for more headroom. Recommended: 0.80.
定义回放分支复用的原请求前缀 token 数；上下文依赖强时提高，资源受限时降低: Set the number of original-request prefix tokens reused by replay branches; increase it for strong context dependence or reduce it when resources are limited. Recommended: 1024.
定义基线分支与候选分支共同评分的未来 token 数；越多比较越稳定，推荐 8。: Set the number of future tokens jointly scored for the baseline and candidate branches; more tokens make the comparison more stable. Recommended: 8.
定义局部惊奇度统计使用的最近 token 数；窗口小响应快但噪声高，窗口大更稳定: Set the number of recent tokens used for local surprise statistics; a smaller window responds faster but is noisier, while a larger window is more stable. Recommended: 8.
定义当前 Attention-Q 相对近期方向的差异触发下限；降低更敏感，提高减: Set the trigger threshold for divergence between the current Attention-Q and its recent direction; lower values are more sensitive, while higher values reduce false triggers. Recommended: 0.35.
定义最近 token 局部平均惊奇度的触发下限；降低更敏感，提高更安静，推荐 0: Set the trigger threshold for the local mean surprise of recent tokens; lower values are more sensitive, while higher values trigger less often. Recommended: 0.8.
定义每个高信息 token 保留的前后上下文宽度；半径越大语义越完整，但更容易超: Set the context width retained before and after each high-information token; a larger radius preserves more complete semantics but is more likely to exceed the budget. Recommended: 16.
定义每次检索进入后续准入的候选文档数；提高增强召回覆盖，降低减少语义审计耗时，推: Set the number of candidate documents sent to the subsequent admission process per retrieval; increase it for broader recall coverage or reduce it to shorten semantic review time. Recommended: 8.
定义汇总当前 Attention-Q 的最近 token 窗口；窗口小更灵敏，窗: Set the recent-token window used to aggregate the current Attention-Q; a smaller window is more responsive, while a larger window is more stable. Recommended: 8.
定义解码期惊奇度与 Attention-Q 漂移的观测级别；主动干预可触发 Se: Set the observation level for decoding-time surprise and Attention-Q drift; Active Intervention can trigger Self-Ask, Observe Only records events, and Off has the lowest overhead.
定义触发后观察多少个未来 token 再判定不确定性恢复；较大更谨慎，较小更快进: Set how many future tokens to observe after a trigger before determining whether uncertainty has recovered; larger values are more cautious, while smaller values enter correction sooner. Recommended: 8.
定义触发点前保留的 Attention-Q 快照数量，用于恢复偏航前的关注上下文: Set the number of Attention-Q snapshots retained before the trigger to restore the attention context from before the deviation. Recommended: 8.
定义触发点后继续采集的 Attention-Q 快照数量，用于确认不确定性是否持: Set the number of Attention-Q snapshots collected after the trigger to confirm whether uncertainty persists. Recommended: 4.
定义调度器同时执行的主请求上限；增大偏吞吐，单人低延迟建议 1～8，默认 64。: Set the maximum number of primary requests the scheduler runs concurrently; higher values favor throughput. For low-latency single-user operation, 1～8 is recommended. Default: 64.
定义轨迹权重随会话轮次指数衰减的半衰期；增大延长历史影响，减小更快遗忘，推荐 4: Set the half-life for exponential trajectory-weight decay across conversation turns; increase it to extend historical influence or reduce it for faster forgetting. Recommended: 4 turns.
定义遥测事件保存请求、输出与 Self-Ask 原文的范围；仅编辑片段兼顾审计与: Set how much original request, output, and Self-Ask text telemetry events retain; Edited Excerpts balances auditability and size, while Full Logging is only for short-term troubleshooting.
审查没有确认任何实质冲突，因此服务端没有生成或写入上下文更正。: The review confirmed no substantive conflicts, so the server did not generate or write a context correction.

工作原理：控制 Attention-Q 与文档 K 相似度的第一道门槛，并同时约: How it works: Controls the initial threshold for similarity between Attention-Q and document K, while also constraining the gap between the top document and the runner-up. Lenient passes more candidates to semantic review; Standard preserves current behavior; Strict filters out weakly relevant or closely matched documents earlier. Recommended: Standard.

由模型将最新工具内容与最近会话上下文进行语义对照；预算自动取模型最大上下文的配置: The model semantically compares the latest tool content with recent conversation context; the budget is automatically set to the configured fraction of the model's maximum context.

确认后，Docker 托管启动器会结束当前进程并自动拉起新进程。模型重新就绪前控: Once confirmed, the Docker-managed launcher will terminate the current process and automatically start a new one. The console will briefly disconnect until the model is ready again.

系统先以严格 Q×K 检索高分候选，再由模型核对因果经验与冲突。 只有表达同一经: The system first uses strict Q×K retrieval to find high-scoring candidates, then the model verifies causal experience and conflicts. Only candidates expressing the same experience are merged atomically; memories that are merely topically similar remain separate. Once started, the task runs in the server background, so you can close the dialog or switch pages.

要求候选分支相对基线的损失改善达到该值才视为有效；调高更保守，推荐 0.02。: A candidate branch is valid only if its loss improvement over the baseline reaches this value; higher values are more conservative. Recommended: 0.02.
要求历史块与当前查询的余弦相关性达到该值才参与控制，推荐 0.0。: A historical block participates in control only if its cosine similarity to the current query reaches this value. Recommended: 0.0.
要求局部惊奇度相对历史基线超过指定增量才触发，减少缓慢波动误报，推荐 0.2。: Trigger only when local surprise exceeds the historical baseline by the specified delta, reducing false positives from gradual fluctuations. Recommended: 0.2.
A new candidate must lead the current winner by this additional margin, preventing repeated switching due to minor noise. Recommended: 0.05.
要求最佳历史块至少领先后续候选该差值，避免在含糊候选之间强行选择，推荐 0.00: The best historical block must lead the next candidate by at least this margin, avoiding forced selection among ambiguous candidates. Recommended: 0.005.
要求轨迹至少经过指定轮次后才参与注意力控制，降低短期回声与重复，推荐 2。: A trajectory participates in attention control only after at least the specified number of turns, reducing short-term echoes and repetition. Recommended: 2.
观测命中后立即启动隐藏 Self-Ask；纠错速度优先时开启，内部请求过多时可关: Immediately start a hidden Self-Ask after an observation hit; enable when correction speed is the priority, or disable if there are too many internal requests.
解压后必须是 UTF-8，最大 8 MB。: After extraction, files must be UTF-8 and no larger than 8 MB.
解码期间持续监测局部惊奇度与 Attention-Q 漂移；触发条件决定 Sel: Continuously monitor local surprisal and Attention-Q drift during decoding; trigger conditions determine the frequency of Self-Ask, candidate refreshes, and replay activation.

超过该轮次的历史块退出候选，避免过期任务状态重新吸引注意力，推荐 16。: Historical blocks older than this number of turns are removed from the candidates, preventing stale task states from attracting attention again. Recommended: 16.
跨轮持久化粗粒度执行状态；长任务建议开启，单轮无状态问答可关闭。: Persist coarse-grained execution state across turns; recommended for long-running tasks, but can be disabled for single-turn stateless Q&A.
轨迹名只使用小写字母、数字、点、横线和下划线。: Use only lowercase letters, numbers, dots, hyphens, and underscores in trajectory names.

问题已定位并修复；验证命令通过。: The issue has been identified and fixed; the verification command passed.
限制一次请求允许的自动干预次数；当前安全上限为 1，0 表示仅观测不触发。: Limits the number of automatic interventions allowed per request; the current safe maximum is 1, and 0 means observe only without triggering.
限制仅从最近若干 token 的轨迹尾部构造候选块，控制扫描成本，推荐 4096: Builds candidate blocks only from the trajectory tail within the most recent tokens to control scan cost. Recommended: 4096.
限制候选分支相对基线的 KL 差异，防止强干预造成分布失真，推荐 4.0。: Limits the KL divergence between candidate branches and the baseline to prevent distribution distortion from strong interventions. Recommended: 4.0.
限制单次请求允许准入的知识 token 总量；防止长文档挤占对话上下文，推荐 8: Limits the total Knowledge tokens admitted per request to prevent long documents from crowding out the conversation context. Recommended: 8192.
限制每个请求的内部任务生成预算；过小会截断审计，过大会增加主请求延迟。开启 Re: Limit the internal task generation budget per request; too small truncates audits, while too large increases main request latency. When Responses context compression is enabled, it must cover the summary budget; 2048 is recommended.
限制每条回放分支注入的参考 token 数，避免长参考改变输出分布，推荐 128: Limit the number of reference tokens injected into each replay branch to prevent long references from altering the output distribution; 128 is recommended.
限制知识候选只能来自 Attention-Q × K 原生检索，关闭词法补充可提: Restrict Knowledge candidates to native Attention-Q × K retrieval only. Disabling lexical supplementation can improve consistency but may reduce recall.
限制策略文档对应的原生状态 token 预算；普通策略推荐 4096，不建议为容: Limit the native state token budget for the policy document; 4096 is recommended for standard policies. Do not increase it to accommodate irrelevant rules.
限制语义准入、Self-Ask 等内部任务的并行度，防止后台负载挤占主请求调度资: Limit concurrency for internal tasks such as semantic admission and Self-Ask to prevent background load from consuming main request scheduling resources; 32 is recommended.
限制进入注意力控制计算的历史块总数，以控制显存、时延和选择噪声，推荐 8。: Limit the total number of history blocks used in attention control computation to control VRAM usage, latency, and selection noise; 8 is recommended.
限制长文档保留为精确 K/V 的高信息 token 总量；提高可增强事实覆盖，降: Limit the total number of high-information tokens retained as exact K/V for long documents. Increasing it improves factual coverage; decreasing it reduces context usage.
限制隐藏推理阶段的最大 token 数；复杂编码任务可提高，延迟敏感任务可降低，: Limit the maximum number of tokens in the hidden reasoning phase. Increase it for complex coding tasks or decrease it for latency-sensitive tasks; 3072 is recommended.

Observer 已触发，但后续没有进入回放终态；触发不等于执行了 Causal: Observer triggered, but no replay terminal state followed. A trigger does not mean Causal Replay ran.
候选分支优于基线，但没有通过 Maybe/KL 门禁；本轮输出未被改写，也没有安: The candidate branch beat the baseline but did not pass the Maybe/KL gate. The current output was not rewritten and no next-turn state was scheduled.
候选分支在同一组未来 token 上优于基线，并通过 KL 门禁；已安排为下一轮: The candidate branch beat the baseline on the same future tokens and passed the KL gate. It was scheduled as recoverable next-turn state.
候选分支相对基线的 NLL 改善不足，回放拒绝切换。: The candidate branch did not improve NLL enough over the baseline, so replay rejected the switch.
候选没有可评分的原生状态或参考 token，回放没有启动分支比较。: The candidate had no scorable native state or reference tokens, so replay did not start branch comparison.
回放只有基线分支，没有可比较的候选分支。: Replay had only the baseline branch and no candidate branch to compare.
回放评分发生 {error}；服务端失败关闭，没有安排下一轮状态。: Replay scoring raised {error}; the server failed closed and scheduled no next-turn state.
回放评分异常；服务端失败关闭，没有安排下一轮状态。: Replay scoring failed; the server failed closed and scheduled no next-turn state.
新候选没有超过当前候选所需的切换边际，回放保持现状。: The new candidate did not clear the required switching margin over the active candidate, so replay kept the current state.
服务端记录了回放终态；可展开原始事件检查完整字段。: The server recorded a replay terminal state. Expand the raw event for the complete fields.
本次请求没有 Causal Replay 终态记录: This request has no Causal Replay terminal record
没有候选通过语义准入，回放未执行候选分支评分。: No candidate passed semantic admission, so replay did not score a candidate branch.
没有可复用的父请求前缀，回放按失败关闭策略停止。: No reusable parent-request prefix was available, so replay stopped under the fail-closed policy.
没有持续不确定性触发，或语义候选未满足回放前置条件。: Persistent uncertainty did not trigger, or semantic candidates did not satisfy the replay prerequisites.
触发点后的真实未来 token 不足，无法进行同窗口因果比较。: There were not enough real future tokens after the trigger for a same-window causal comparison.
历史上下文已失效，正在重新建立: The previous server context expired; rebuilding a fresh context
